inspirationNote: Class-for-class match with upstream's InputGroup/InputGroupAddon/InputGroupButton/InputGroupText/InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea, all semantic tokens (text-muted-foreground, border-destructive, ring-destructive). InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea author their own flush classes rather than composing the installed Input/Textarea and overriding their fixed classes, since adico_lib::cn has no Tailwind-merge equivalent to make class-attribute override order reliable. No dioxus-components equivalent exists.
